# Threat coverage

The T1–T10 threat model from the plan's §3.0, and for each threat the control
and the tests that are its evidence. Every file listed here is checked to exist
and to hold a test by its threat's suite, and `pnpm test:security` runs exactly
these files. A gap is work a later row owns; it is named, never hidden, and it
shows as a `todo` in every run.

## T1 — Embed a stolen `pk_` on their own site

**Control.** Global-unique verified origin + server-side `Origin` check + origin-bound token

**Suite.** [`packages/security/test/threats/T1-widget-theft.test.ts`](../../packages/security/test/threats/T1-widget-theft.test.ts)

| Evidence | Runs as | What it proves |
|---|---|---|
| [`apps/api/test/widget-cors.test.ts`](../../apps/api/test/widget-cors.test.ts) | unit | Origin checked server-side, exact echo, one refusal for every wrong pair |
| [`apps/api/test/widget-cors.integration.test.ts`](../../apps/api/test/widget-cors.integration.test.ts) | integration (Postgres) | the same check over the real accessor and policies, incl. every P2-06 bypass string |
| [`packages/db/test/widget-resolution.integration.test.ts`](../../packages/db/test/widget-resolution.integration.test.ts) | integration (Postgres) | a key resolves only with its own tenant's verified origin |
| [`packages/db/test/tenant-domains.integration.test.ts`](../../packages/db/test/tenant-domains.integration.test.ts) | integration (Postgres) | one origin, one tenant: the global unique index |
| [`apps/api/test/widget-token.test.ts`](../../apps/api/test/widget-token.test.ts) | unit | a token presented from another origin, or with none, is refused |
| [`apps/e2e/test/cross-origin.spec.ts`](../../apps/e2e/test/cross-origin.spec.ts) | browser (Playwright) | a real browser on an unverified origin is refused |

**Gaps.** _No known gap._
